question.text: Within how many working days of the closure of a delisting offer must the public announcement regarding the outcome be made?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.226-p.227, within 2 working days of the closure of the delisting offer, the promoter/acquirer and the merchant banker must make a public announcement in the same newspapers disclosing one of three outcomes: (i) the success of the offer and the final price, (ii) the failure of the offer, or (iii) rejection of the discovered price by the promoter. The Trap: Other durations (1, 3 or 5 working days) are not specified in the source for this post-closure public announcement requirement. Note: The announcement must be made in the same newspapers that were used for the initial public announcement of the delisting offer.
